title: Embedding: Google + Cohere adapters
description:
Implement Google and Cohere embedding provider adapters from docs/plans/01-ai-core.add01.md §8.2-§8.3.

Required reading: docs/plans/00-implementation-guide.md

Google adapter (§8.2):
- API ID: "google-embeddings"
- Single: POST {baseUrl}/models/{model}:embedContent
- Batch: POST {baseUrl}/models/{model}:batchEmbedContents
- Request mapping: texts → requests[i].content.parts[0].text, TaskType → taskType (8 enum values), Dimensions → outputDimensionality, Encoding ignored (float only)
- Response mapping: embeddings[i].values → Embedding.Values, usage estimated from input text
- Google-specific task type mapping (RETRIEVAL_QUERY, RETRIEVAL_DOCUMENT, SEMANTIC_SIMILARITY, CLASSIFICATION, CLUSTERING, QUESTION_ANSWERING, FACT_VERIFICATION, CODE_RETRIEVAL)

Cohere adapter (§8.3):
- API ID: "cohere-embeddings"
- POST {baseUrl}/embed
- Request mapping: texts, TaskType → input_type (required, defaults to "search_document"), Dimensions → output_dimension, Encoding → embedding_types
- Response mapping: embeddings.float[i] → Values, embeddings.int8[i] → Raw, meta.billed_units.input_tokens → Usage.Tokens
- Cohere requires input_type — adapter must default to "search_document" when TaskType is unspecified

Both: HTTP client, auth, error handling, RegisterEmbeddingProvider, unit tests with mock HTTP server.
Follow the OpenAI adapter pattern established in the pattern leader task.

Depends on: OpenAI adapter (pattern leader).
